LUOSKO German Shepherd Dog Rescue is a small independent registered charity (#1188407) set up to responsibly rescue, rehabilitate and re-home German Shepherds who find themselves in difficult situations. 

Funded pretty much entirely by the public donations, we normally re-home around 100+ dogs each year. 

At any one time we have around 50 dogs in our care, in our center in Cheadle, foster homes or in holding kennels awaiting suitable foster or adoption homes. We operate on a national basis so our dogs can be homed in most areas throughout the UK.

Part of our responsible re-homing process we try to match our dogs to potential families, we normally organise several face to face meetings and home visits before our dogs go to their final adoption families, which has significantly reduced the amount of dogs coming back into rescue and increased our successful adoptions creating extremely happy families.
